localFacts.fact: idealista's help centre advises shooting rooms in horizontal format and keeping the camera straight (ángulo recto) for vertical lines; shooting from a chair or crouching is only for special effects, and the tripod is the ally when light is low.

IACrea's real estate photo guide puts the camera between 1 m and 1,30 m from the floor; eye height gives a high angle that makes the room look smaller, knee height distorts proportions. It also says a tripod keeps the same shooting height from room to room.

Spain's Ley de Propiedad Intelectual, art. 35.2: works permanently located in parks, streets, squares or other public ways may be reproduced freely by photography. General information, not legal advice: shoot exteriors from the public street.
Benro Europe publishes 153 cm maximum height with the centre column retracted for the TMA38CL, a figure the US page leaves out.
Spanish terms: rótula de cremallera / rótula de engranajes (geared head), rótula de 3 vías, rótula de bola, columna central, base niveladora, zapata; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: Raising the centre column costs stability, so photographers want enough height with the column down.
localPainPoints.fix: Choose by column-down height (Manfrotto 290 Xtra 147,5 cm, MT190XPRO4 135 cm, Benro 153 cm per Benro Europe) and keep the column down.

quotes.text: Desde luego cuanto menos se tenga que echar mano de la columna central más estabilidad gana el conjunto.

localPainPoints.pain: Working out real camera height: the head and camera add height on top of the legs.
localPainPoints.fix: For interiors you only need 1 to 1,30 m (IACrea) or 1,2 to 1,5 m (Aryeo), so every tripod here reaches it with the column down; the head adds a little more.

quotes.text: cuenta la altura de la rótula unos 10cm y otros 8-10 de la cámara

localGain.point: Spanish professional height range (1 to 1,30 m, IACrea) next to Aryeo's 1,2 to 1,5 m, showing column-down height is plenty.
Benro's European column-down figure (153 cm) for the TMA38CL.
idealista's own advice: horizontal format and a straight camera.
Art. 35.2 LPI for exteriors from the public street.
